name: lookup_care_resident
description: Look up a care-home resident by room. Read back the returned identity and confirm before creating a request.

name: create_care_request
description: Record a confirmed resident care request for staff review. Does not call, page, transfer, or dispatch anyone.

resident_id.description: ID returned by lookup_care_resident and confirmed by the caller

quote.description: Original caller words, verbatim where available

location.description: Only if away from their room; otherwise empty

reported_by.description: Resident, visitor, or staff reporting; no phone numbers

facility_category.description: For maintenance requests, the kind of room incident to link to shared facilities work

access_ok.description: Only include after the resident explicitly confirms permission or refusal to enter. Omit when unknown.
